Enum Class EnemyType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<EnemyType>
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.enemies.EnemyType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<EnemyType>, Constable
public enum EnemyType extends Enum<EnemyType>
The enemy types, as a polymorphic dispatcher over the Abstract Factory.

Each constant knows (a) which factory method creates its concrete enemy and (b) whether it prefers the air path. This keeps the wave-string → creation mapping and the "is this a flying enemy" question in one place, so the spawner in Game needs no switch and no string comparison.

The actual path is still chosen by the game loop (it depends on the GameMap, which the factory must not know about), but it keys on usesAirPath() instead of a hard-coded string compare.

Open/closed: a new enemy type means adding a constant here (and a factory method) — Game is never touched.
